ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are two circular celestial bodies; the lower-left celestial body is labeled m1, and the upper-right celestial body is labeled m2; the two are located at the two ends of the same straight line, and the middle black point O is on the line connecting the two; two arrows are respectively along the tangent directions of their respective circular motions, indicating that the two undergo uniform circular motion around the common center O. Reasoning: Let the distances from m1 and m2 to O be respectively r1 and r2. Since the binary stars always rotate around the same center O and remain on the same straight line, they have the same angular velocity ω, so v1=ωr1, v2=ωr2. The binary stars move around the common center of mass, satisfying m1r1=m2r2, therefore r1/r2=m2/m1. Substituting into the linear velocity relationship gives v1/v2=r1/r2=m2/m1, namely m1v1=m2v2. Therefore the linear velocity of a celestial body is inversely proportional to its mass.

method.method_draft: 先从图像读出：两个天体 m1、m2 位于同一直线两端，中间点 O 在两者连线上，速度箭头均沿各自圆周的切线方向，表示二者绕同一圆心 O 做匀速圆周运动。再从题干读出：这是双星系统，两天体质量分别为 m1、m2，绕连线上某点 O 做匀速圆周运动。解题时设两星到 O 的距离分别为 r1、r2。由于二者始终在连线上并绕同一中心转动，它们具有相同角速度 ω，因此 v1=ωr1，v2=ωr2。双星绕共同质心运动，满足 m1r1=m2r2，所以 r1/r2=m2/m1。代入线速度关系得 v1/v2=r1/r2=m2/m1，即 m1v1=m2v2，因此天体的线速度与其质量成反比。
